scope: Read-only review of original A110 CDC classification draft and linked actual source/netlist evidence; no hardware or tool execution, no gate waiver.
conclusions: The CDC-8 destination is actual routed FDCE sync_2_reg with empty ASYNC_REG and PCIe AXI clock period 4ns; generated three-stage reset logic does not remove this missing physical attribute.
Vendor user_lnk_up_cdc and user_reset_cdc are actual ASYNC_REG-marked XPM reset chains; generated source DEST_SYNC_FF=2 is consistent with downstream register and CDC depth observations.
ResetWrangler threshold of 5500 slow-clock ticks is a 55MHz qualification counter followed by deglitch and per-domain reset chains, not an asynchronous release/MTBF proof.
All 36 findings remain pending. The 35 structural explanations are proposed classifications only; strict CDC acceptance and board signoff remain false.
Positive recovery slack cannot substitute for asynchronous reset protocol or metastability evidence.
requested_wording_clarifications: G1 is a combined asynchronous reset qualification chain, including runtime PCIe user_reset causes, rather than exclusively cold-reset initialization.
G3 sys_or_hot_rst includes cfg_hot_reset_out and user_lnk_up_int depends on PHY link status. The 10000-cycle upstream fundamental reset qualification does not cover every vendor-internal reset event.
author_response: A110 agent agreed to clarify G1/G3 and retain every pending disposition, with no additional hardware run.
final_assessment: Draft accurately records the actual observations and limits. All 36 pending dispositions and false strict_cdc_acceptance/board_signoff retained. The 35 structural suggestions are not approval or acceptance.
